itens.titulo: Bradesco lucraria até R$ 500 milhões a mais com juros abaixo de 10%, diz Noronha
itens.descricao: Bradesco lucraria até R$ 500 milhões a mais com juros abaixo de 10%, diz Noronha Exame
trechos: Balanço do Bradesco: o banco divulgou lucro líquido recorrente de R$ 7,1 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 14,6% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025 (Leandro Fonseca/Exame) Publicado em 23 de outubro de 2026 às 11h17.
Última atualização em 23 de outubro de 2026 às 11h24.

O banco Bradesco (BBDC4) poderia ter registrado lucro entre R$ 400 milhões e R$ 500 milhões maior no terceiro trimestre de 2026 se os juros estivessem abaixo de 10%, afirmou o CEO Marcelo Noronha nesta sexta-feira, 23.
A instituição reportou lucro líquido recorrente de R$ 7,1 bilhões, alta anual de 14,6%, enquanto provisões e inadimplência avançaram.

O Bradesco (BBDC4) poderia ter registrado um lucro até R$ 500 milhões maior no terceiro trimestre de 2026 se os juros estivessem abaixo de 10%, afirmou Marcelo Noronha, presidente-executivo do banco, em entrevista coletiva nesta sexta-feira, 23.
“Se tivéssemos vento de popa, com uma economia crescendo mais e juros abaixo de 10%, poderíamos ampliar a carteira de crédito em 20% e entregar um lucro R$ 400 milhões a R$ 500 milhões maior.
Mas essas condições estão fora do nosso controle”, disse Noronha.
A declaração ocorre um dia depois de o Bradesco divulgar lucro líquido recorrente de R$ 7,1 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 14,6% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025.

itens.titulo: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
itens.descricao: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports CoinDesk
trechos: - The Federal Reserve's interest rate decision was Robinhood's largest event contract in September, while crypto contracts have moved toward 15-minute settlement periods.

"We've now started to see price volatility contracts, such as bitcoin, crude oil, gold, start to dominate the marketplace, and they're the fastest growing products that are out there," Mackenzie said.
Traders are also moving toward shorter contracts, particularly in crypto, where some products now settle in as little as 15 minutes.
It's moved to a day, and now we're down to 15 [minutes]," he said.
Asked about the risks, he compared 15-minute crypto contracts to zero-day options, which expire on the same trading day.
"What you see them do is almost immediately start to build out into equities, crypto, futures, options," he said.
Robinhood has 11 businesses generating more than $100 million in annual revenue each, Mackenzie said, noting that prediction markets could be the company’s fastest-growing segment among them.
Diversified RWA stablecoins sustain 5-7% yield from real credit as crypto funding compresses to ~4%.

itens.titulo: Bradesco vê crescimento de inadimplência generalizada, mas carteira protegida, diz CEO
itens.descricao: Bradesco vê crescimento de inadimplência generalizada, mas carteira protegida, diz CEO Exame
trechos: Marcelo Noronha, CEO do Bradesco: “De uma forma geral, para o mercado, não só para nós, há uma pressão no índice de inadimplência e tem pressão de crédito, sim”, afirmou (Bradesco/Divulgação) Publicado em 23 de outubro de 2026 às 10h33.
Última atualização em 23 de outubro de 2026 às 11h23.
O banco Bradesco (BBDC4) prevê que a pressão sobre a inadimplência e o custo do crédito persistirá por mais tempo, afirmou o CEO Marcelo Noronha nesta sexta-feira, 23.
No terceiro trimestre, o lucro recorrente subiu 14,6% em um ano, para R$ 7,1 bilhões, mas as provisões avançaram 24,3%, para R$ 10,6 bilhões.
A inadimplência acima de 90 dias chegou a 4,6%.

O Bradesco (BBDC4) espera que a pressão sobre a inadimplência e o custo do crédito continue por um período mais longo, diante do comprometimento da renda das famílias, dos juros elevados e da desaceleração da economia.
A previsão dos economistas é de um crescimento de [Produto Interno Bruto] PIB de 1% para 2027.
Os dados remetem a um crescimento de inadimplência generalizada no mercado”, disse Noronha.

itens.titulo: AI Pivot Fails to Slow Bitcoin Mining Competition as Hashrate Surges
itens.descricao: AI Pivot Fails to Slow Bitcoin Mining Competition as Hashrate Surges Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin's network hashrate has risen above 1 zettahash per second for the first time since March, a seven-month high, even as the largest publicly traded miners divert computing power to artificial intelligence, according to BlocksBridge Consulting.
The seven-day average, equal to 1,000 exahashes per second, is the highest since March 3, BlocksBridge said in its Miner Weekly newsletter.
CryptoQuant data cited by its founder, Ki Young Ju, put the total about 45% above the July low near 726 exahashes per second.
16, and BlocksBridge expects another 5.16% increase at the next adjustment, which would bring the two-step rise to about 11.4%.
"That's hardly the breathing room remaining miners might have expected from the AI migration," the firm wrote.
BlocksBridge reported earlier that publicly traded miners' realized hashrate fell 23% while their AI and high-performance computing revenue rose 52% in a quarter, through the second quarter of 2026.
It put the displaced equipment at roughly $1.5 billion.
Riot's second-quarter data center revenue was $23.2 million, against $113.7 million from mining.

itens.titulo: Pre-Q3 Earnings: Is Alphabet Stock a Portfolio Must-Have?
itens.descricao: Pre-Q3 Earnings: Is Alphabet Stock a Portfolio Must-Have? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Alphabet GOOGL is set to report third-quarter 2026 results on Oct.
For third-quarter 2026, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for earnings is pegged at $2.94 per share, up by a penny over the past 30 days, and indicating 2.44% year-over-year growth.
The consensus mark for third-quarter revenues is pegged at $111.64 billion, implying growth of 27.63% from the year-ago quarter's reported figure.
Its earnings outpaced the Zacks Consensus Estimate in all the trailing four quarters, with the average surprise being 86.65%.
In the second quarter of 2026, cloud revenues surged 82% year over year to $24.77 billion, while cloud backlog reached $514 billion, increasing by more than $50 billion sequentially.
In the second quarter of 2026, Search & Other revenues increased 17% year over year to $63.27 billion, primarily supported by retail and financial services advertisers.
However, GOOGL cautioned that third-quarter growth comparisons would become tougher as Alphabet laps the acceleration in Search performance that began in third-quarter 2025.
Alphabet's third-quarter 2026 performance is likely to have benefited from growth in YouTube advertising, supported by direct-response campaigns, brand advertising, Shorts and connected television.

itens.titulo: Brokers Suggest Investing in Nvidia (NVDA): Read This Before Placing a Bet
itens.descricao: Brokers Suggest Investing in Nvidia (NVDA): Read This Before Placing a Bet Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Nvidia currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.13, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 53 brokerage firms.
An ABR of 1.13 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.
Of the 53 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 49 are Strong Buy and three are Buy.
Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 92.5% and 5.7% of all recommendations.
Our research shows that for every "Strong Sell" recommendation, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations.
ABR Should Not Be Confused With Zacks Rank In spite of the fact that Zacks Rank and ABR both appear on a scale from 1 to 5, they are two completely different measures.
The ABR is calculated solely based on brokerage recommendations and is typically displayed with decimals (example: 1.28).
It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.
